title: SSQ-to-DPA clause auto-fill and indemnity exposure scorer
creator: Samira Khalid
description:
Background: Sales and Legal spend significant time translating Security Self Questionnaires (SSQs) and customer answers into contract redlines for DPA/MSA indemnity and liability clauses. For pricing experiments, legal concessions and indemnity exposure directly impact quotes and approval paths. This initiative builds an automated bridge from SSQ answers to pre-filled DPA clause suggestions and an indemnity exposure score that feeds pricing gating and sales preflight.

Objectives:
1) Ingest standard SSQ exports (JSON/CSV) and map answers to clause templates and fallback language.
2) Compute an indemnity exposure score (0-100) based on mapped clauses, data residency requirements, escrow/backup requests, and requested liability caps.
3) Surface suggested clause edits in Sales UI (quick-insert, justification) and a machine-readable redline payload for Legal review.
4) Integrate exposure score into pricing gate (auto-approve threshold vs manual legal review trigger) for pricing experiments.

Scope / Out of scope:
- In scope: definitional mapping, scoring heuristic, mock UI surface, proto automation for low-risk auto-approve.
- Out of scope: full automated signature, changes to SLA wording, KMS/HSM implementation.

Acceptance criteria:
- End-to-end ingestion accepts three SSQ formats and creates mapped clause suggestions for 90% of high-frequency questions.
- Exposure score correlates with historical legal escalation outcomes (AUC target >= 0.78 on retrospective dataset).
- Sales UI mockup implemented and user-tested with SEs, with usability score >= 4/5 in pilot.
- Pricing gate integration triggers manual legal review when score >= 65 and auto-approves when <= 30.
- Audit log emitted for every automated suggestion with pointer to source SSQ and mapping rationale.

Success metrics:
- Reduce average legal review time for small/medium deals by 40% in pilot accounts.
- Increase self-serve closure rate on pricing experiments by 8% for accounts below exposure threshold.
- False positive auto-approvals < 2% in first 3 months of rollout.

Implementation notes:
- Use a rules-first model with ML-backed scoring for ambiguous answers; keep rules editable in a config repo for rapid iteration.
- Mapping artifacts stored in Drive: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/SSQ-Mappings
- Confluence PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PRD/SSQ-to-DPA+AutoFill
- Prototype GH repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ssq-dpa-proto (branch: pm-31789)

Risks and mitigation:
- Overfitting to historical escalations: mitigate with holdout dataset and periodic calibration.
- Sales overreliance on suggestions: add clear UI banners and one-click escalate to legal.
- Security sensitive answers leakage: ensure mapping service runs in VPC/private deployment for enterprise pilot.
